comparison.objective: Candidate secures a rail to rack posts; record fits a spring tension rod between cupboard walls so spring friction alone supports it.
comparison.physical_skill: Both manipulate a long spring-loaded member and require level released support. Candidate additionally depresses a tab, inserts paired prongs at separated front/rear posts, telescopes without losing engagement, and drives screws; record compresses and seats two end caps against planar walls.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks four hole engagements, full spring extension, rack-unit match, prescribed screws, and 3 s support; record checks both caps bearing, height band, level/square placement, clearance, and released stillness.
comparison.reason: This is a close long-member neighbor, but frictional compression between walls is mechanically different from staged positive latching plus fastening. Candidate needs numeric level, prong, spring-force, and retention-load thresholds.
